async_and_reload.current: No async or reload operation exists at the B1 provider boundary; each fetch is synchronous and reparses the package index.
async_and_reload.original: GetResourceAsync returns an IAsyncRequest surface with IsReady/GetResource; ReloadResource is separate from GetResource. Worker scheduling, cancellation, polling cadence, and cache invalidation are unresolved.

availability_and_failure.current: B1 distinguishes parse/index, missing identity, extent, QFS, and size errors through false plus error text; typed decoders add their own format/domain errors.
availability_and_failure.original: Manager and database APIs return bool/nullable handles without a stable captured error taxonomy. Cell preload helpers are void and can skip null/zero child content; effect-map failure can log and continue.

cache_temporality.current: No cache or eviction. DbpfResourceProvider reparses the index per fetch and owns only the output vector; MemoryResourceProvider is a test-only map.
cache_temporality.original: The SDK exposes cache-before-load GetResource, explicit private bypass, cache insertion, filtered flush, and cache lists. Exact eviction and final-release timing are not recovered.

current_openspore_order: Caller resolves a full (type, group, instance) key.
DbpfResourceProvider::fetch parses the DBPF index for every request.
findDbpfEntry performs an exact linear identity scan.
extractDbpfRecord validates extent and copies raw bytes or runs QFS decompression.
The output vector is passed to a format decoder/consumer.
CellGfx::preloadResources currently stores key pairs only; it does not acquire the records.
CellModeStrategy::onEnter calls CellGfx::startDisplay; this is current clean-room behavior, not original runtime evidence.
dependency_order: Initialize the resource manager before registering databases/factories/caches.
Mount or register package databases and load their indexes before identity lookup.
Resolve the complete ResourceKey before record selection; nested instance-only Cell references need type/group context.
Open a record and read/decode bytes before factory creation and cache insertion.
Retain ResourceObject/record/presentation handles until all consumers release them.
Initialize Cell world/layer handles before preload, preload associations before display, and stop display before final dispose.
Release entity/effect/model/presentation owners before world/database/renderer teardown.
original_static_order: The SDK/interface and current live Ghidra call graph support a manager/registry -> database/index -> record/factory -> ResourceObject/cache chain.
The cCellGFX Initialize body creates ordered world/layer/shadow handles before the SDK-described preload phase.
PreloadResources recursively walks Cell and populate references and invokes model/effect/texture/creature preload helpers.
Mode OnExit and Dispose are the static teardown anchors; exact ordering and release fanout remain incomplete.
ownership_rules: Original ResourceObject has a refcount and ResourceKey; CachedResourceObject adds a final-release callback.
Original IRecord/PFRecordRead expose key, database, stream, RecordOpen, RecordClose, RecordInfo, offset, size, and stream-refcount fields.
Original DatabasePackedFile stores index state, a ResourceKey-to-record map, and manager pointer; DatabaseDirectoryFiles stores a ResourceKey record-list map.
Current B1 returns owned bytes and therefore has no persistent record/resource handle cache.
Current CellModeStrategy owns CellGfx/UI value members, which differs from original global singleton ownership.
